name: Groa
title: Sawmistress of the Great Saw
examine: Forearms like the beams she cuts and a permanent squint from thirty years of sighting down grain. Shout twice. She is deaf on the left and unembarrassed about it.
lines: OTHER side. I do not hear a thing out of that ear and I never will.
A board is a promise. Cut it wet and you are lying to a roof.
That wheel has turned since my grandmother. I have replaced every part of it twice.
